mapper.select: SELECT id, content_hash, hash_algorithm, file_size, mime_type, storage_provider, bucket_name, object_key, storage_status, reference_count, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM sys_file_object WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash} AND file_size = #{fileSize} AND storage_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file_object ( content_hash, hash_algorithm, file_size, mime_type, storage_provider, bucket_name, object_key, storage_status, reference_count, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{contentHash}, #{hashAlgorithm}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType}, #{storageProvider}, #{bucketName}, #{objectKey}, #{storageStatus}, #{referenceCount}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )

INSERT INTO sys_file ( file_object_id, original_name, extension, uploader_id, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{fileObjectId}, #{originalName}, #{extension}, #{uploaderId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT file.id, file.file_object_id, file.original_name, file.extension, file.uploader_id, object.content_hash, object.file_size, object.mime_type, object.storage_provider, object.bucket_name, object.object_key, file.created_by, file.updated_by, file.created_at, file.updated_at, file.deleted_at FROM sys_file file JOIN sys_file_object object ON object.id = file.file_object_id AND object.deleted_at = 0 WHERE file.id = #{id} AND file.uploader_id = #{uploaderId} AND file.deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT file.id, file.file_object_id, file.original_name, file.extension, file.uploader_id, object.content_hash, object.file_size, object.mime_type, object.storage_provider, object.bucket_name, object.object_key, file.created_by, file.updated_by, file.created_at, file.updated_at, file.deleted_at FROM sys_file file JOIN sys_file_object object ON object.id = file.file_object_id AND object.deleted_at = 0 AND object.storage_status = 'AVAILABLE' WHERE file.id = #{id} AND file.deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT file.id, file.file_object_id, file.original_name, file.extension, file.uploader_id, object.content_hash, object.file_size, object.mime_type, object.storage_provider, object.bucket_name, object.object_key, file.created_by, file.updated_by, file.created_at, file.updated_at, file.deleted_at FROM sys_file file JOIN sys_file_object object ON object.id = file.file_object_id AND object.deleted_at = 0 AND object.storage_status = 'AVAILABLE' WHERE file.id = #{id} AND file.deleted_at = 0 AND ( file.uploader_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_delivery_report_attachment binding JOIN biz_delivery_report report ON report.id = binding.report_id AND report.deleted_at = 0 WHERE binding.file_id = file.id AND binding.deleted_at = 0 AND (report.reporter_id = #{userId} OR #{canReadAllReports} = TRUE) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM biz_task_file_binding binding JOIN biz_task task ON task.id = binding.task_id AND task.deleted_at = 0 WHERE binding.file_id = file.id AND binding.deleted_at = 0 AND (task.creator_id = #{userId} OR task.owner_id = #{userId}) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_feedback_file_binding binding JOIN sys_feedback feedback ON feedback.id = binding.feedback_id AND feedback.deleted_at = 0 WHERE binding.file_id = file.id AND binding.deleted_at = 0 AND ( feedback.submitted_by_id = #{userId} OR #{canManageFeedback} = TRUE ) ) ) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_task_file_binding WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_feedback_file_binding WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_delivery_report_attachment WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND deleted_at = 0
